as_written_in_papers.quote: a new c.925-927dup (p. Val309dup) mutation at TNFAIP3 gene

cases.statement: One carrier: Patient 1, a 3-year-old Chinese child with arthritis and IBD-like colitis, from a three-patient series.

people.label: Patient 1
people.sex: female (one sentence in the case text says 'boy'; see concerns)
people.key_phenotypes: polyarthritis (ankles, knees, PIP joint); intermittent fever; diarrhoea with bloody stool; multiple colorectal ulcers; growth delay; IgA below 0.0647 g/L

quotes.quote: A 3 years and 2 months girl was admitted with “swelling and pain in multiple joints for 6 months and intermittent fever with diarrhoea for over 4 months”.

Multiple colorectal ulcers on endoscopic examination and a new c.925-927dup (p. Val309dup) mutation at TNFAIP3 gene on subsequent whole-exome genetic testing suggested a diagnosis of A20 haploinsufficiency
the height and weight of the patient were in the 3rd percentile for the same sex and age, suggesting growth delay
Immunity tests showed IgA was less than 0.0647 g/L, and IgG and IgM were normal.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Arthritis and colorectal ulcers with fever. Infections (TB, fungi, parasites, EBV) were tested and negative, and the ANA panel was negative. The patient had low IgA. Whole-exome sequencing was done, but the paper names no other candidate variants for this patient.

quotes.quote: Tests for tuberculosis, fungal infection, parasite infection, Epstein-Barr virus, and other pathogens were negative.
The antinuclear antibody (ANA) panel was negative.
In our 3 patients, patient 1 presented primarily with arthritis and inflammatory bowel disease

de_novo.statement: Reported as a spontaneous (de novo) change, confirmed by Sanger sequencing. Blood was taken from each child and both parents, and Figure 2 shows sequence maps for Patient 1's father and mother. Parentage confirmation is not reported.

quotes.quote: c.1906 + 1G > C and c.925_927dup were confirmed by Sanger sequencing as spontaneous mutations.
approximately 2 mL (EDTA anticoagulant) of peripheral blood was collected from each child and their parents
b Map of gene mutations of Patient 1’s father. c Map of gene mutations of Patient 1’s mother

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: In-frame three-nucleotide duplication predicted to add one valine (p.(Val309dup)), with no frameshift. The paper describes the disease as loss of TNFAIP3 function.

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is caused by a germline mutation with a highly penetrant loss of TNFAIP3 function.

computational_predictions.statement: No variant-specific prediction. GERP conservation is reported only for the other two variants in the series. Cohort-level: candidate filtering used SIFT, PolyPhen2, MutationTaster and GERP++.

quotes.quote: Among these mutations, c.1906 + 1G > C and c.547C > T were predicted by GERP++ as loci in a conserved region.
In addition, the results predicted from SIFT, PolyPhen2, MutationTaster, GERP++, and other databases, which were pathogenic, loci served as disease-related candidate loci.

population_data_in_papers.statement: Absent from 1000 Genomes, ESP6500si, ExAC (all and East Asian) and an in-house set of 1000 individuals.

quotes.quote: All of those mutations do not appear in 1000 Genomes Project, ESP6500si, ExAC_ALL, ExAC_EAS, or myGenostics 1000 normal individual databases.

authors_classification.statement: The authors give a hedged statement covering all three patients.

quotes.quote: Based on these results, our 3 patients showed the possibility of pathogenicity at genetic level.

concerns: The paper contradicts itself on sex. Patient 1 is called a 'girl' and 'her', but one sentence says 'a 91 cm and 11.5 kg boy'. The methods give 1 male and 2 female in the series.
The case text writes 'c.925-927dup' (hyphen) and the results write 'c.925_927dup'. They are the same variant. No transcript is stated.
In-frame duplication, so the predicted consequence differs from the truncating variants that make up most of this disease's variant spectrum. No functional data.
Very low IgA (< 0.0647 g/L) suggests an additional immune finding. No other genetic cause is discussed.
notes_for_panel: De novo is stated, with both parents sampled. Parentage confirmation is not mentioned. No affected relatives are described.
